title: World Currencies
description: All ISO 4217 currencies with alpha-3 code, numeric code, minor unit and the territories that use them.

id.description: ISO 4217 alpha-3 code, used as the record id

numeric.description: ISO 4217 numeric code, zero padded to three digits

minorUnits.description: Decimal digits in the minor unit; null where the registry says N.A.

countries.description: Territories listed against this currency in ISO 4217 list one
